story: I don’t want to be the pink elephant in the room
text: Has anyone seen the scene from SV where Jared is excited after they hired a woman engineer? And Jared expects her to be pals with Monica because both are female? I feel some of us men behave that way. :( link to clip: [VIDEO]

story: Four times I felt discriminated against for being a female developer
text: This SV clip says it for me. In the words of Guilfoyle "... we should hire the best person for the job. Period." [1] [1] [VIDEO]

story: Amazon scraps secret AI recruiting tool that showed bias against women
text: Yes. There is a bonus to being a woman in this situation, all other things being equal. Silicon Valley did a good bit on this [VIDEO] It's funny because it's true.
All the talk about "diversity" in tech companies always reminds me of this Silicon Valley scene - [VIDEO] . Still the perfect representation of the entire effort.
